nodes.text: give teaching with wise words
to those who are glad to live wisely.
Moreover, it has also been said of him
by scripture that he truly
in every form
set forth its nature,
how it was formed by nature,
whether it were tree, herb or grass,
not according to human dreams;
and from the first cedar tree
that Mount Lebanon still bears
down to the moss that grows
from rot on a wall
he explained without end,
in a wise survey,
how each thing according to its kind
was and is formed by nature.
Besides, his wise skill set out
how to all living things their life
is given by nature
according to its order.
He also composed conjurations;
with the great power of the words
he worked magic, and with their mastery.
